text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on the camera just like that, please! Looking great~! All right, one more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, Chrono Genesis was being interviewed
for the Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the Umamusume chosen as number one in the fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: F-First place in the final results too... I-I won...!
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure...?
choice_data_list: Your hard work has been recognized.
Your hard work has been recognized

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The voices of the people who likely voted for her were written in column comments, fan letters, social media posts, and more.

text_block_list.name: Comment on Column
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to this history column, racing became much more exciting.
I want to see what kind of race Chrono-san runs after teaching us that."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: "'I was completely captivated by Chrono-chan's running at the Takarazuka Kinen. Next up, consecutive Grand Prix titles!'"

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel her respect for the classic Royal Road.
As a racing fan, nothing could make me happier."
choice_data_list: Everyone's dying to see Chrono run!
Everyone wants to see you run, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I want to live up to these expectations.
I will win consecutive Grand Prix titles at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
After this, I'm planning to meet up with Love-chan
to go shopping for the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's our big moment, after all. We were talking about, y-you know... putting effort into makeup and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The post positions for the Arima Kinen are decided in a public lottery drawing.
The entire event is even broadcast live on television.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're here, so we might as well enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Well then, Trainer. See you tomorrow.
choice_data_list: See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...The lottery is on Christmas Eve...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"You've done so much for me, Trainer...
So, like... a present, maybe...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll take a little peek...?
I-If it's to thank him, there's nothing weird about it, right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Parting ways with Chrono Genesis, I headed to Tracen Academy.
Just as I was about to cross the pedestrian crossing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw a small Umamusume
running toward me from ahead.
choice_data_list: Hm? That girl... I wonder if she's okay?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mama, look!
I got even faster, didn't I!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold on!
Watch your surroundings properly—
choice_data_list: Look out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Skreeeeeech!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"—Chrono Genesis-san.
Please report to the Chairwoman's office immediately."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...What could that be?
I shall go and take a look.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry to summon you so suddenly.
Actually, yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer was involved in an accident
and will be hospitalized for a while.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-An accident...!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't anything life-threatening.
However, she did get injured...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...It's hard to take in all at once, isn't it.
Why don't you go visit them in the hospital?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Waking from slumber, the first thing I saw was the ceiling.
choice_data_list: (This really... isn't a dream, right...)
(This really... isn't a dream, is it...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pain throughout my body thrusts reality upon me.
Enduring the pain, I shifted the orientation of my body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I remember why I was brought to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A young Umamusume ran into the crosswalk
and was about to be hit by a left-turning car...
Without thinking, I jumped between her and the vehicle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, that Umamusume was uninjured...
though I ended up being rushed away in an ambulance myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she hurt her bone, and has been ordered to take absolute bed rest.
choice_data_list: (Hospitalized for the rest of the year...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The image of Chrono Genesis comes to mind.
choice_data_list: (I can't even train Chrono properly...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no regrets about saving the girl, but...
there was no denying I had really messed up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a substitute instructor will oversee the training.
However, that isn't the problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It will undoubtedly
shake her up quite a bit.
choice_data_list: (Of all people, for me—her Trainer—to...!)
(Of all people, for me—her Trainer—to...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Lamenting won't change our situation.
Now that it's come to this, all we can do is figure out the best way to handle it...!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: !! Chrono...! Please, come in!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ......E-Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...! ...Trainer, sa... *sob*...
choice_data_list: Sorry! I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!
Sorry! I'm so sorry for causing trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
...Please... don't apologize...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: As long as Trainer is safe, that's all that matters...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hic... I-I'm sorry............
Ugh... I c-can't stop... hic.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
S-Seeing your face just made me feel so relieved...
I'm sorry...
choice_data_list: Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm alright now.
So... please don't worry."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard about the training schedule.
I'll make sure to adjust properly leading up to the Arima Kinen."
choice_data_list: Even if I'm in the hospital, I can still put together a training menu for you!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You must not...!
Please get some proper rest, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...P-Please don't worry about training.
We have the 'Genesis Method', after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...Building on your guidance, Trainer... I'll show you I can do this on my own."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Please believe in me... and in the days we've spent together up until now."
choice_data_list: ...All right. But let me know if anything feels wrong.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...If I look anxious, Trainer won't be able to focus on recovering...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I have to do my best on my own...!)

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I know it will be tough, but I'll support you
with everything I have until the Arima Kinen. Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Thank you very much...!
...Um, th-this is for you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I analyzed past race results and the like,
and applied them to my training strategy.
U-Up until now, it's been done in this manner...

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... That's amazing!
With this, we should be able to follow a policy similar to before!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
I-I'll be in your care...!

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Goal! The time is... well.
It's dropped a bit, but considering it was just yesterday, it's understandable.

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text: "It's okay, we can just make adjustments from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... U-Um...
There's not many d-days left until the Arima Kinen, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll put together a self-training routine...
Could you please... take a look over it...?

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
However, don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, I've received permission for independent training.
Next week's schedule is just as I sent you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I receive a regular report from Chrono Genesis.
The phone calls were always brief."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
""Everything is going smoothly on our end.
Please rest easy. Well then... until next time.""
choice_data_list: Yeah... See ya.
Yeah... see you later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stare reluctantly at the call ended screen on my smartphone.
If all goes well, that's great, but...
choice_data_list: If possible, I'd like to check properly...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, you're always here beside me
as if it's the most natural thing in the world..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
Out for some morning self-training too, Chrono-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: G-Good morning. You too, Grass-san...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Would you like to join me if you'd like~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...It turned out just as I expected.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I hope you don't mind me speaking up, but—Chrono-chan, I really wouldn't recommend doing solo training by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She seemed somewhat distracted.
If someone isn't there to warn her,
she might end up hurting herself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right now... rather than solo training,
I think it would be better for you to stay by Trainer's side.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Are you not going to pay them a visit?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if I come by too often,
I might be a bother to you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Chrono-chan. Do you remember what I mentioned before
about the important element when building history?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... An Umamusume and a fan, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. And... there is one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I talk a little about myself?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to win three Grand Prix races in a row
is because I had someone supporting me by my side all along.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
After winning the Asahi Hai FS,
as you know, I got injured...
and I've finally managed to make it to my comeback race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, in that comeback race—I wasn't able to produce results...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...We were defeated in the next race as well, and as a result,
we ended up skipping our planned entry in the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That person continued to support me throughout.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Accept me just as I am, when all I can do is swallow my bitter regret.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even when my results were poor and voices of disappointment came in,
she always shielded me...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...You could have chosen to leave me,
and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that person continued to encourage me.
—They remained by my side through it all."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Because someone is naturally by your side,
ordinarily, you might not even realize
just how precious their presence is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yet beside every Umamusume who built an era,
there was always someone supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
An indispensable presence for building racing history...
Umamusume and fans, and the other one is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...An irreplaceable, precious existence...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
By continuing to walk forward together,
the bond deepens, and an Umamusume becomes stronger.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer wants that as well.
If you're worried about troubling them,
I think it would be best to ask them directly.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I want to move forward together with Trainer... But... is it really okay for me to do that...?)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, a message. From Trainer...!"
choice_data_list: "Good work. Chrono, I have a favor to ask."
"Good work. Chrono, I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Please let me do as much of my Trainer work
as I can from my hospital room.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for Chrono Genesis's
regular report.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...
Um, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Chrono! You came!
Chrono! You came!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I am terribly sorry for dropping in so suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... c-could I discuss my training plan... with you, if you don't mind...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much...!
I-I took a video, too. I brought it with me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After checking the video, her conditioning seemed on track.
I pointed out a few areas of concern and
presented a training plan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that menu is
better suited for me, then...
I had completely overlooked that perspective...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... is asking for advice like this today
a b-burden to you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her today, I felt like I finally understood.
She held back from consulting me because she
didn't want to cause me any trouble.
choice_data_list: Not at all. If anything, I'd like you to come to me for advice more often.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... t-thank goodness...
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, the time looks good.
Let's wrap it up here for today.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Thank you very much for your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Lately... your running form has become very stable.
It has a nice sense of ease to it, too.

text_block_list.name: Guest Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to win the Arima Kinen.
There are no guarantees in racing, but I'm certain of it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! Th-Thank you so much...!
I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to the advice they gave me the other day...
things are going super well, so I have to let them know!)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, your progress is going smoothly.
However, please continue to rest for a while longer.
choice_data_list: Will I be discharged in time for the "Arima Kinen"?!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That would be difficult...
She hasn't even reached the stage where she can start rehab.
Discharge will likely be after the new year.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Discharge from the hospital is... after the new year......)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer said it was fine, but...
maybe they shouldn't have been working at all...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Because I looked so insecure...
maybe they asked for work just as an excuse to call me over.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (And yet... I ended up leaning on Trainer... and pushing them too hard...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Wishing that I could...
keep walking alongside Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best, all on my own...!
